blocks.zh: Section 1: Analytical Target Profile & Knowledge/Risk Management｜分析目標輪廓與知識/風險管理
blocks.en: Section 1: Analytical Target Profile & Knowledge/Risk Management

blocks.zh: §3 分析目標輪廓（ATP）
blocks.en: §3 Analytical Target Profile (ATP)

blocks.zh: 概念辨析：QTPP → CQA → ATP — 品質規劃三層階層
blocks.en: Concept Clarification: QTPP → CQA → ATP, a Three-Level Quality Planning Hierarchy

blocks.zh: Q14 建立了一套前瞻性品質規劃的三層階層結構，每一層都服務於下一層：
blocks.en: Q14 establishes a three-level hierarchy for prospective quality planning, in which each level serves the next:

blocks.zh: 邏輯鏈：QTPP 定義產品要什麼 → CQA 識別哪些屬性需要量測 → ATP 定義量測那些 CQA 的分析方法需達到什麼標準
blocks.en: Logic chain: the QTPP defines what the product needs → the CQAs identify which attributes must be measured → the ATP defines the standard that the analytical procedure measuring those CQAs must meet

blocks.zh: 類比：ATP 是分析方法的「職務說明書（Job Description）」
blocks.en: Analogy: The ATP Is the "Job Description" of the Analytical Procedure

blocks.zh: 在設計一個分析方法（「僱用一個員工」）之前，必須先定義這個方法需要做什麼、達到什麼標準。
blocks.en: Before designing an analytical procedure ("hiring an employee"), you must first define what the procedure needs to do and the standard it must meet.

blocks.zh: ATP 就是這份「職務說明書」：
blocks.en: The ATP is that "job description":

blocks.zh: 職位目的 → 分析方法的預期用途（例：定量放行規格中的特定雜質）
blocks.en: Purpose of the position → the intended purpose of the analytical procedure (e.g., quantifying a specific impurity in the release specification)

blocks.zh: 工作內容 → 待測產品屬性的細節（例：手性雜質 A，濃度範圍 0–0.2%）
blocks.en: Job content → the details of the product attribute to be measured (e.g., chiral impurity A, concentration range 0–0.2%)

blocks.zh: 績效標準 → 性能特性與對應標準（例：準確度 ±10%；精密度 RSD ≤ 5%）
blocks.en: Performance standards → the performance characteristics and their criteria (e.g., accuracy ±10%; precision RSD ≤ 5%)

blocks.zh: 先有 ATP（職務說明書），才選技術（面試候選人），才開發方法（訓練員工），才驗證（試用期考核）。
blocks.en: First the ATP (job description), then the technology is selected (interviewing candidates), then the procedure is developed (training the employee), then it is validated (probation assessment).

blocks.zh: 重要澄清：ATP 提交是「可選的（optional）」
blocks.en: Important Clarification: Submitting the ATP Is "Optional"

blocks.zh: Q14 明確指出：ATP 的正式文件化和提交是可選的，並非法規強制要求。
blocks.en: Q14 states explicitly that formal documentation and submission of the ATP is optional and is not a regulatory requirement.

blocks.zh: 無論是否提交，ATP 作為內部開發工具都有價值，有助於團隊對分析方法需求達成共識。
blocks.en: Whether or not it is submitted, the ATP has value as an internal development tool, helping the team reach a shared understanding of the requirements for the analytical procedure.

blocks.zh: §3 ATP 驅動技術選擇與生命週期管理
blocks.en: §3 The ATP Drives Technology Selection and Lifecycle Management

blocks.zh: ATP 驅動的分析方法開發序列流程
blocks.en: The ATP-Driven Analytical Procedure Development Sequence

blocks.zh: Q14 描述了一個以 ATP 為起點的線性序列：
blocks.en: Q14 describes a linear sequence that starts with the ATP:

blocks.zh:
QTPP + CQA 識別
↓
ATP 建立
[定義：預期目的 / 待測屬性 / 性能標準]
↓
技術選擇（Technology Selection）
[問：哪種技術能滿足 ATP 的性能標準？考量操作環境]
↓
分析方法開發（Analytical Procedure Development）
[風險評估 → 參數研究（DoE）→ PAR/MODR 確立]
↓
驗證（Validation per ICH Q2）
[ATP 性能標準 → 驗證接受標準；開發數據可用於驗證]
↓
例行使用 + 持續監控
↓
變更管理（以 ATP 為基準評估 fit for purpose）
blocks.en:
QTPP + CQA identification
↓
ATP established
[Defines: intended purpose / attribute to be measured / performance criteria]
↓
Technology Selection
[Question: which technology can meet the ATP performance criteria? Consider the operating environment]
↓
Analytical Procedure Development
[Risk assessment → parameter studies (DoE) → PAR/MODR established]
↓
Validation per ICH Q2
[ATP performance criteria → validation acceptance criteria; development data can be used for validation]
↓
Routine use + continued monitoring
↓
Change management (assessing fit for purpose against the ATP)

blocks.zh: 關鍵特性：ATP 在整個生命週期中持續存在，每次評估修改後的方法是否仍「適合預定用途」時，ATP 都是判斷基準。
blocks.en: Key feature: the ATP persists throughout the lifecycle and is the benchmark each time a modified procedure is assessed for whether it is still "fit for the intended purpose".

blocks.zh: 技術選擇時的操作環境考量
blocks.en: Operating Environment Considerations in Technology Selection

blocks.zh: ATP 不只定義分析性能標準，還應考量操作環境對技術選擇的影響：
blocks.en: The ATP defines not only the analytical performance criteria but should also consider how the operating environment affects technology selection:

blocks.zh: 操作環境需求（如需要 in-line 即時量測）會直接限制可選的分析技術，因此 ATP 中應明確說明操作環境需求。
blocks.en: Operating environment requirements (such as the need for in-line real-time measurement) directly limit which analytical technologies can be chosen, so the ATP should state the operating environment requirements explicitly.

blocks.zh: §4.1 知識管理
blocks.en: §4.1 Knowledge Management

blocks.zh: 分析方法生命週期中的知識管理：內部 vs. 外部先驗知識
blocks.en: Knowledge Management in the Analytical Procedure Lifecycle: Internal vs. External Prior Knowledge

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 的知識管理原則被正式引入分析方法開發領域。先驗知識（Prior Knowledge）是加速開發、降低風險的核心資產：
blocks.en: The knowledge management principles of ICH Q10 are formally brought into analytical procedure development. Prior knowledge is a core asset for speeding up development and reducing risk:

blocks.zh: 平台分析方法（Platform Analytical Procedure）的效益：對於可應用於多種產品的成熟方法（如 UV 法測定蛋白質含量），可直接利用現有先驗知識，省略重複的基礎開發，部分驗證測試亦可基於科學/風險理由省略。
blocks.en: Benefits of a platform analytical procedure: for an established procedure that can be applied to many products (such as a UV method for protein content), existing prior knowledge can be used directly, repeated basic development can be omitted, and some validation tests can also be omitted on scientific/risk-based grounds.

blocks.zh: 「主動管理（actively managed）」的實踐意涵
blocks.en: What "Actively Managed" Means in Practice

blocks.zh: Q14 要求知識需在整個產品生命週期中「主動管理」，不只是被動儲存：
blocks.en: Q14 requires that knowledge be "actively managed" throughout the product lifecycle, not merely stored passively:

blocks.zh: 累積：開發數據、驗證結果、例行監控數據均納入知識庫
blocks.en: Accumulate: development data, validation results and routine monitoring data are all added to the knowledge base

blocks.zh: 分析：定期分析趨勢，識別方法性能漂移的早期信號
blocks.en: Analyze: analyze trends regularly to identify early signals of drift in procedure performance

blocks.zh: 應用：將新知識應用於風險評估更新（§4.2）和變更決策
blocks.en: Apply: apply new knowledge to risk assessment updates (§4.2) and change decisions

blocks.zh: 傳承：透過 PQS（ICH Q10）確保知識不因人員異動而流失
blocks.en: Transfer: use the PQS (ICH Q10) to ensure that knowledge is not lost when staff change roles or leave

blocks.zh: 知識管理與風險管理（§4.2）是相互支撐的：先驗知識為風險評估提供輸入，風險評估結果又成為新的知識被管理。
blocks.en: Knowledge management and risk management (§4.2) support each other: prior knowledge provides input to risk assessment, and the results of risk assessment in turn become new knowledge to be managed.

blocks.zh: §4.2 風險管理
blocks.en: §4.2 Risk Management

blocks.zh: QRM 在分析方法開發中的四大應用
blocks.en: Four Applications of QRM in Analytical Procedure Development

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 的 QRM 工具（Ishikawa 圖、FMEA 等）被明確應用於分析方法開發的四個方向：
blocks.en: The QRM tools of ICH Q9 (Ishikawa diagrams, FMEA, etc.) are explicitly applied in four areas of analytical procedure development:

blocks.zh: 風險評估的時機：「開發早期執行，隨資訊更新」
blocks.en: Timing of Risk Assessment: "Performed Early in Development and Updated as Information Becomes Available"

blocks.zh: Q14 明確強調風險評估應在開發早期（early in development）執行，並隨著更多信息的獲得持續更新：
blocks.en: Q14 stresses that risk assessment should be performed early in development and continually updated as more information is obtained:

blocks.zh: 開發早期：基於先驗知識（§4.1）進行初始風險評估 — 此時數據有限，可採非正式方式（informal）
blocks.en: Early in development: an initial risk assessment based on prior knowledge (§4.1); data are limited at this stage, so an informal approach is acceptable

blocks.zh: 開發過程中：實驗數據（DoE、穩健性研究）累積後更新風險評估，調整高/低風險分類
blocks.en: During development: update the risk assessment once experimental data (DoE, robustness studies) have accumulated, adjusting the high/low risk classification

blocks.zh: 驗證前：更新後的風險評估確認哪些性能特性需要驗證、驗證的嚴格程度
blocks.en: Before validation: the updated risk assessment confirms which performance characteristics need to be validated and how rigorously

blocks.zh: 上市後：例行監控數據（趨勢、OOS/OOT 調查）觸發風險評估更新
blocks.en: Post-approval: routine monitoring data (trends, OOS/OOT investigations) trigger an update of the risk assessment

blocks.zh: 風險評估可以是正式（formal）或非正式（informal）的，關鍵是有記錄、有邏輯，並與先驗知識相連結。結果必須記錄於 PQS（ICH Q10）中。
blocks.en: Risk assessment can be formal or informal; what matters is that it is documented, logical and linked to prior knowledge. The results must be recorded in the PQS (ICH Q10).

blocks.zh: Ishikawa 圖在 HPLC 方法風險評估中的典型應用
blocks.en: A Typical Application of the Ishikawa Diagram in HPLC Procedure Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 以 HPLC 純度測定方法為例，Ishikawa 圖的「魚頭」= 方法性能目標（例：雜質量測準確度 ±10%）
blocks.en: Taking an HPLC purity procedure as an example, the "head of the fish" in the Ishikawa diagram is the procedure performance goal (e.g., impurity measurement accuracy ±10%)

blocks.zh: 「魚骨」的六個典型分類（5M1E）：
blocks.en: The six typical categories of the "fishbone" (5M1E):

blocks.zh: 儀器（Machine/Equipment）：管柱類型、偵測器波長、溫度控制、泵流速準確度
blocks.en: Equipment (Machine): column type, detector wavelength, temperature control, pump flow rate accuracy

blocks.zh: 試劑/材料（Materials）：溶劑純度、緩衝液 pH 值配製、參考標準品品質與效期
blocks.en: Materials: solvent purity, buffer pH preparation, quality and expiry of the reference standard

blocks.zh: 方法（Method/Parameters）：流速、梯度程式、注射體積、進樣順序
blocks.en: Method (Parameters): flow rate, gradient program, injection volume, injection sequence

blocks.zh: 操作（Man/Analyst）：樣品製備步驟、溶解程序、稀釋操作
blocks.en: Man (Analyst): sample preparation steps, dissolution procedure, dilution operations

blocks.zh: 量測（Measurement）：積分方法、偵測波長選擇、校正模型
blocks.en: Measurement: integration method, choice of detection wavelength, calibration model

blocks.zh: 環境（Environment）：實驗室溫度、濕度對樣品和管柱的影響
blocks.en: Environment: the effect of laboratory temperature and humidity on the sample and the column

blocks.zh: 綜合練習題
blocks.en: Comprehensive Exercises

blocks.zh: 應用練習題
blocks.en: Application Exercise

blocks.zh: 某生物藥廠計劃開發一個針對生物藥品（biological drug product）某 CQA 的全新分析方法。
blocks.en: A biopharmaceutical manufacturer plans to develop a brand-new analytical procedure for a CQA of a biological drug product.

blocks.zh: 什麼是 ATP（分析目標輪廓）？
blocks.en: What is an ATP (Analytical Target Profile)?

blocks.zh: ATP 應包含哪些核心元素？
blocks.en: What core elements should an ATP contain?

blocks.zh: ATP 何時應向法規機構提交？是否為強制要求？
blocks.en: When should the ATP be submitted to the regulatory authority? Is submission mandatory?

blocks.zh: 解答
blocks.en: Answer

blocks.zh: 1. ATP 的定義：
blocks.en: 1. Definition of the ATP:

blocks.zh: ATP（Analytical Target Profile，分析目標輪廓）是對一項分析量測的前瞻性描述，說明此分析方法需達到的預期目的和性能特性標準。它是在實際開發分析方法之前建立的「量測需求規格書」，類似製程開發中的 QTPP 概念。
blocks.en: The ATP (Analytical Target Profile) is a prospective description of an analytical measurement, stating the intended purpose and the performance characteristic criteria that the analytical procedure must meet. It is a "measurement requirements specification" established before the procedure is actually developed, similar to the QTPP concept in process development.

blocks.zh: 2. ATP 的核心元素（Q14 §3）：
blocks.en: 2. Core elements of the ATP (Q14 §3):

blocks.zh: 預期目的（intended purpose）：此分析方法用於量測什麼？用於哪個決策（放行、穩定性、製程監控）？
blocks.en: Intended purpose: what is the procedure used to measure? Which decision does it support (release, stability, process monitoring)?

blocks.zh: 待測產品屬性（product attributes to be measured）：具體的品質屬性、樣品基質類型、預期濃度或含量範圍
blocks.en: Product attributes to be measured: the specific quality attribute, the type of sample matrix, and the expected concentration or content range

blocks.zh: 性能特性與對應標準（performance characteristics with criteria）：例如選擇性、準確度目標值、精密度（RSD）上限、偵測限要求等
blocks.en: Performance characteristics with criteria: for example selectivity, target accuracy, upper limit for precision (RSD), detection limit requirements, etc.

blocks.zh: 量測要求（measurement requirements）：操作環境（off-line / at-line / in-line）、通量需求等
blocks.en: Measurement requirements: operating environment (off-line / at-line / in-line), throughput requirements, etc.

blocks.zh: 3. ATP 提交時機與強制性：
blocks.en: 3. Timing and mandatory status of ATP submission:

blocks.zh: ATP 的正式文件化與提交是可選的（optional），並非法規強制要求。
blocks.en: Formal documentation and submission of the ATP is optional and is not a regulatory requirement.

blocks.zh: 建議提交時機：採用 Enhanced approach 開發；希望與審評機構在驗證接受標準上預先達成共識；作為 PACMP（預先核准變更方案）的基礎文件
blocks.en: Recommended times to submit: when the enhanced approach is used for development; when you want to reach early agreement with the assessors on validation acceptance criteria; as a basis document for a PACMP (Post-Approval Change Management Protocol)

blocks.zh: 提交優點：有助於法規溝通，無論採用哪種開發方法均可提交；可減少審評問題；明確驗證接受標準的合理性依據
blocks.en: Benefits of submission: it facilitates regulatory communication and can be submitted whichever development approach is used; it can reduce review questions; it makes clear the rationale for the validation acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: 不提交亦可：但仍需在驗證報告中說明性能標準的科學合理性，且 ATP 可作為內部開發工具使用
blocks.en: Not submitting is also acceptable: but the validation report must still explain the scientific justification for the performance criteria, and the ATP can be used as an internal development tool
